subject: what scale is the spde summary.random in?

messages.author: e183a94721e02db4
messages.subject: what scale is the spde summary.random in?
parts:
I have a very basic question but can't seem to find the answer.

I am using a Poisson spatiotemporal model and I am visualising the space-time random effect (model$summary.random). 

I know it is normally distributed - but is it on a log scale? Does the exponential of the random effect relate to the response scale? 

Kind regards

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] what scale is the spde summary.random in?
parts:
inla.doc("poisson")

give the info.

the model is in the linear predictor scale, for the poisson, this means
that the mean of the poisson is

exp(linear.predictor)

as the default link is the log

H
